description: Inventory of retained fork-only core patches. fork-drift-check.py evaluates each probe against upstream/main so absorbed features can be removed. Standalone extensions live in DysektAI/pi-extensions.
notes: Scope: retained fork-only patches on local, plus branches deliberately NOT merged. Standalone extensions keep development branches in this repo but ship from DysektAI/pi-extensions (see the notes below); listing them as features would falsely imply local carries their code.
Standalone extensions and read-outline behavior ship from DysektAI/pi-extensions. Their development branches are not merged into local or included in this core patch inventory.
Absorbed upstream, no entry needed: feat/max-thinking-level. refactor/deduplicate-shared-utils was only partly absorbed; its remaining delta is listed as a feature.

Retired by user preference: feat/model-selector-provider-first and feat/user-bash-header. The model selector and user-invoked Bash display now use upstream rendering. Agent tool headers remain in DysektAI/pi-extensions.

Moved to DysektAI/pi-extensions (v0.5.0) and removed from local: [Thinking] label (thinking-label), [X Tool] call headers + path colour + VS Code paths (tool-headers), inline-code path links (path-links), Synthetic provider (synthetic), compaction.maxContextTokens (context-management). Dropped without replacement: toolPath theme token and missing-token warning, pi.getExtensions() (startup-welcome uses tool/command sourceInfo), stripGhostTokens (never called).

features.summary: Fork maintenance tooling: CHANGELOG merge driver, rerere setup, sync scripts, the tracked consumer job (.fork/local-sync.sh + .fork/systemd units), docs.

drift.note: Tooling is inherently fork-only; upstream will never carry it. Probe stays ACTIVE.

features.summary: Configurable code block border styles in the TUI markdown renderer.
Bounds vitest worker concurrency to prevent host overload.

drift.note: REDUNDANT if upstream ships its own worker-cap script at this path.

features.summary: Surface errors via stderr (avoid TUI corruption), add stack traces, preserve OAuth error cause.
Unit tests for previously untested pure-logic modules across all packages.

drift.note: Supplemental changelog, AI utility, MIME, and TUI editor tests remain downstream. Tests for the removed experimental agent harness were dropped during the 1.0.0 sync. This probe flags absorbed parseChangelog coverage; re-verify the other suites before dropping.

features.summary: OpenAI-compatible streams surface a clear authentication-failure message naming the provider on HTTP 401/403, instead of an opaque status-code error.

drift.note: REDUNDANT if upstream adds its own auth-failure messaging for 401/403 in openai-completions.

features.summary: OpenCode Zen/Go requests carry an opencode/<version> User-Agent, an OpenCode-shaped ses_ session header, and inert bash/read tool declarations so the free-tier gate accepts Pi (all request paths, including compaction and compat complete()). Kept in core: an extension cannot preserve builtin routing for other providers, credential-pool key rotation, and models.json custom models at once.

drift.note: REDUNDANT if upstream sends OpenCode client identity and session headers itself.

features.summary: Verified fork source checkouts follow DysektAI/pi-fork GitHub releases for version checks, and `pi update --self` fast-forwards the checkout to origin/local and rebuilds (config.ts, version-check.ts, package-manager-cli.ts, release changelog URL). See FORK.md 'Releases and self-update'.
Anthropic streams re-derive fresh-only input tokens from overlapping input/cache buckets on every usage event, including proxy deltas that omit input_tokens.

drift.note: REDUNDANT if upstream normalizes Anthropic input vs cache buckets itself.

features.summary: withRemoteCatalog leaves providers that implement refreshModels unwrapped so their own refresh/persistence runs and an empty pi.dev overlay cannot overwrite their cached catalog.

drift.note: REDUNDANT if upstream skips wrapping native dynamic providers.

features.summary: Model scope patterns containing glob characters first try an exact model reference, and invalid thinking-level suffixes produce a diagnostic instead of breaking the match.

drift.note: REDUNDANT if upstream resolves exact references before glob expansion.

features.summary: coding-agent truncateTail preserves byte-truncation classification; read tools shell-quote the absolute path in the over-long-line bash hint. The removed experimental agent harness no longer supplies shared truncation exports.

drift.note: REDUNDANT if upstream preserves byte classification when the byte and line limits both apply. Re-check the read-tool quotedPath hint separately before dropping.

features.summary: Review follow-ups kept in core: Vertex accepts Google Cloud metadata credentials without an ADC file, the external editor passes the prompt path through an env var under a shell, and aborted compaction summaries throw AbortError.

drift.note: REDUNDANT if upstream supports Vertex metadata-server credentials; re-check external-editor.ts and compaction.ts separately.

features.summary: Validate supplied authorization-response issuers without server metadata, and remove both named and legacy OAuth credentials on sign-out.

drift.note: Re-check both issuer validation and McpOAuthCredentialStore.remove before dropping these credential fixes.
